warmup.description: Activate full body with emphasis on core stability and unilateral coordination.

main_exercises.name: Barbell Deadlift
main_exercises.load_guidance: Moderate load at 7/10 effort, leaving 2 reps in reserve
main_exercises.form_cue: Keep bar close and drive through the floor with a braced core

main_exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline Bench Press
main_exercises.load_guidance: Choose a weight you could perform 12 reps with, stopping at 8-10
main_exercises.form_cue: Lower with control and press without flaring elbows excessively

main_exercises.name: Goblet Lateral Squat
main_exercises.load_guidance: Moderate load allowing full depth and control in lateral movement
main_exercises.form_cue: Sit into one hip while keeping the opposite leg straight

main_exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Single-Arm Shoulder Press
main_exercises.load_guidance: Moderate load that challenges stability without compromising posture
main_exercises.form_cue: Brace core and avoid leaning as you press overhead

main_exercises.name: Renegade Row (Dumbbell)
main_exercises.load_guidance: Light to moderate load focusing on control and anti-rotation
main_exercises.form_cue: Keep hips steady and avoid twisting as you row

cooldown.description: Restore mobility and reduce tension after full-body effort.
movements: Hip flexor stretch x 30s each side

phase_notes.menstrual: Focus on controlled, steady movement and reduce load if needed—this session’s variety allows you to scale easily. Prioritize comfort and avoid pushing intensity.
phase_notes.follicular: You can increase load or reps slightly, especially on deadlifts and presses. This is a good phase to build confidence in both strength and coordination.
phase_notes.ovulatory: Take advantage of peak energy to move with power and precision—push toward the higher end of rep ranges while maintaining strong core stability.
phase_notes.early_luteal: Maintain consistent effort and focus on clean execution, especially in unilateral and stability-based exercises. Avoid rushing between movements.
phase_notes.late_luteal: Keep loads moderate and prioritize control—reduce complexity if needed by slowing tempo. This session works well when approached with intention over intensity.
